## Description
What needs to change and why. Who is it for, and what problem does it solve?

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Observable, testable outcome
- [ ] Another outcome
- [ ] Edge case or error state handled

## Out of Scope
What this issue deliberately does not cover.
